class.name: NetwPersistenceConfig
class.brief_description: Which row of which [NetwDatabase] one entity loads and saves.
class.description:
The declaration belongs to the node that made it, so two players running one script keep two record ids. Every column of [method schema] is filled by one property that named it through [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted], and a column left unbound refuses the whole entity. [method Netw.configure_database] and [method Netw.database] resolve the session through the [SceneTree], so a database is declared from [method Node._ready] rather than from [method Object._init]. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"position", false) \ .persisted(game.save_schema.column_ref(0)) Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(&"saves") \ .schema(game.save_schema) \ .record_id(account_name) \ .interval(5.0)
func account_name() -> StringName: return entity.entity_id [/codeblock] [method record_id] is read once, when the entity binds, and the id it answered is the row every later save writes. Moving the account the provider reads never retargets an enrolled save. A key that changes between sessions, such as a peer id, reads a different row every time the player joins. The row is reached through [NetwPersistenceHandle], as [member NetwEntity.persistence].

method.name: database
method.description: Names the [NetwDatabase] this entity's row lives in. The name resolves in the same session, so [method Netw.configure_database] declares it first. Returns the same config so the declaration chains.

method.name: interval
method.description: Saves the whole row this often while anything in it has changed. [code]0.0[/code] saves only when the game calls [method NetwPersistenceHandle.save]. Returns the same config so the declaration chains. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: load_on_spawn
method.description: Whether the stored row is read before the entity plays. Returns the same config so the declaration chains. The session authority starts the read when the entity's node is ready, and no peer receives the entity until it settles. [codeblock lang=text] read settles ┠╴row found the row is applied, then the entity is sent to peers ┠╴no row the entity is sent with the values it spawned with ┖╴failed the entity is not sent until a retried load succeeds [/codeblock] [method NetwPersistenceHandle.load] retries a failed read. A bound property that changes while the row is being read fails the read, and the stored row is not applied over it.

method.name: record_id
method.description: Answers the key this entity's row is stored under. It is called once, when the entity binds, and must answer a nonempty [StringName]. Returns the same config so the declaration chains.

method.name: schema
method.description: Declares the shape of this entity's row. Every [NetwColumnRef] a property binds comes from this same [NetwSchema], and one taken from another schema refuses the binding whatever its index. Returns the same config so the declaration chains.
